cv: Senior Mechanical Design Engineer. Built a 40-part CadQuery library driven from YAML specs used by 12 engineers; introduced GD&T and tolerance stack-ups on every assembly; wrote the team's parametric-spec guide.
SolidWorks designer, 8 years of sheet-metal and machined parts. Owns a 300-variant design table. No scripting beyond Excel-driven configurations.
FreeCAD technician, 3 years. Models brackets and enclosures for a small workshop; writes occasional Python macros. Self-taught.
3D-printing hobbyist. Designs simple prints in Tinkercad and Fusion hobby tier. No engineering background.
Marketing coordinator, 5 years. Runs campaigns in HubSpot, writes copy. Has never used a CAD tool.
Backend engineer, 6 years in Python and Go. Builds APIs and data pipelines. No mechanical or CAD experience.
Mechanical engineer with deep GD&T expertise. Runs tolerance stack-ups and DFM reviews daily; documents every decision. Light Python for analysis.
Architectural drafter, 10 years in AutoCAD. Produces plans and sections. No parametric or code-driven work.
Engineering student, one semester of SolidWorks and a MATLAB course. Some project experience, no industry work.
Product designer using Figma and Blender for renders. Focus on visuals and UX, not engineering or manufacturing.
Manufacturing engineer, 7 years. Programs CNC and CAM, reads and edits CAD models for tooling. Writes G-code by hand.
OpenSCAD enthusiast. Maintains a library of parametric models shared on Thingiverse; comfortable with modules and variables.
Data scientist, 5 years in Python and SQL. Builds models and dashboards. No engineering or geometry background.
Robotics engineer. Works daily with URDF, kinematics and inverse kinematics. Uses CAD only to import meshes into simulators.
Furniture carpenter, 20 years. Builds by hand from sketches. No digital tools.
Aerospace engineer. Works on surface modeling and G-code for composites; writes Python scripts to generate toolpaths.
Frontend developer, 4 years in React. Builds web apps. No CAD or geometry work.
CAD instructor. Teaches parametric modeling and GD&T; has written course materials and graded hundreds of student models.
Hobbyist who reverse-engineers parts: 3D-scans objects and rebuilds them in Fusion. Self-taught, no formal training.
Structural engineer using Revit. Defines load paths and sections; does not write parametric scripts.
